Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — cutover & rollback plan (technical)

Attaching the draft runbook; below are the concrete cutover steps and rollback triggers I added (high-level). Please review and call out any additional dependencies.

Planned cutover steps (estimated timeline):
1) Pre-cutover (T-72h): final backup + DB snapshot; toggle maintenance page; notify users
2) T-2h: deploy canary model to dedicated pool, validate KV cache warming
3) T-30m: disable new ingestion; begin final token sync and queue drain
4) T-10m: switch routing to dedicated endpoint (DNS TTL pre-lowered)
5) T+0: smoke test (automated) — expect 2–3 quick sanity checks (see script in runbook)
6) T+15m: full traffic ramp to 100% in 10m increments while monitoring p95/p99 and error rate
7) Post-cutover (T+2h): confirm billing export and retention logs are present

Rollback triggers (examples):
- sustained p99 > 1200ms for 5 minutes
- error rate > 2% for 3 consecutive minutes
- critical functionality failing (authentication, generate endpoint 5xx)

Rollback procedure (short):
- Initiate DB restore from snapshot taken at T-72h
- Revert routing to previous stable endpoint (DNS rollback)
- Re-enable queued ingestion and validate replay on staging before production retry

Expected expected outage window (if rollback): short maintenance — we expect < 2 minutes for routing swap but complete rollback including verification ~60–90 minutes.

Attachment: runbook_draft.md (detailed steps + automated smoke-test scripts)

Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
